agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, July 17, 2018 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Traina
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-k, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Special Meetings of June 18, 2018 and June 19, 2018 and the Regular Meeting of June 19, 2018
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.

c.

ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.

ACTION: That the report be received and filed.

ACTION: That the report be received and filed.

ACTION: That the report be received and filed.

ACTION: That the report be received and filed.

i.
May Treasury & Investment Report
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7i
j.
Distribution of Lomita Golf Tournament Proceeds
ACTION: Staff is recommending the distribution of funds in the amount of $6,917.18 to the various programs as outlined in the staff report.
Item #7j
k.
Update on the Public Works Director position (Recruitment and Interim Position)
ACTION: Adopt resolution amending the FY 2018-19 Compensation Plan/Salary Schedule to reflect the revised salary for the Public Works Director Position; and approve the attached revised job description for Public Works Director.
Res 2018-23 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita amending Resolution No. 81-56, a Resolution establishing a compensation plan for employees for Fiscal Year commencing July 1, 2018 and ending June 30, 2019.
Item #7k
PUBLIC HEARINGS
8.
PUBLIC HEARING - DETERMINATION ON WHETHER THE BID OF GRFCO, INC. FOR THE 250TH STREET WATER MAIN REPLACEMENT AND STREET REHABILITATION PROJECT IS RESPONSIVE AND WHETHER GRFCO IS A RESONSIBLE BIDDER
Presented by Interim Public Works Director Vander Neut
Res 2018-24 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, determining that GRFCO, Inc. is not a responsible bidder for the 250th Street Water Main Replacement and Street Rehabilitation Project and that the bid is non-responsive.
Mayor to open the hearing.
Item #8
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
9.
CONSIDERATION OF AN AWARD OF AGREEMENT TO STEPHEN DORECK EQUIPMENT RENTALS, INC. FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF 250TH STREET WATER MAIN REPLACEMENT AND STREET REHABILITATION AND DORIA AVENUE WATER MAIN REPLACEMENT PROJECT
Presented by Interim Public Works Director Vander Neut
ACTION: That the City Council:
1.
Approve the plans and specifications for the 250th Street Water Main Replacement and Street Rehabilitation Project and Doria Avenue Water Main Replacement; and
2.
Award a Public Works Agreement to Stephen Doreck Equipment Rentals, Inc. in the amount of $1,447,508 for the construction of the project; and
3.
Approve a total budget of $1,592,258.80 (which includes a 10% contingency for unforeseen conditions) for the Agreement; and
4.
Authorize the City Manager to execute the Public Works Agreement.
Item #9
10.
REQUEST FOR RED CURB ON THE EAST SIDE OF PENNSYLVANIA AVENUE SOUTH OF 249TH STREET ACTION: That the City Council approve the installation of 27 feet of red curb on the east side of Pennsylvania Avenue between the fire hydrant at the southeast corner of 249th Street and a point 27 feet southerly.
Item #10
11.
DISCUSSION AND POSSIBLE AUTHORIZATION TO APPLY FOR MSRC AND ATP GRANTS
Presented by Community Development & Economic Director Velasco & Interim Public Works Director Vander Neut
Res 2018-25 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita authorizing the submittal of an active transportation grant application for the Lomita Corridor Pedestrian Safety Improvement Plan Project in the amount of $983,200.
Res 2018-26 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita authorizing the submittal of an active transportation Program Grant Application for the Walnut Street Intersection Improvement Project in the amount of $654,350.
1.
Approve by minute order a change of previously allocated Mobile Source Air Pollution Reduction (MSRC) funds from $6,250 to $7,900 to accommodate a different make and model of electric vehicle than originally approved; Lomita City Council Meeting Agenda0July 17, 2018
2.
Approve by resolution the authorization of a grant application to CalTrans and MSRC in the amount of $998,800 of which $15,600 are MSRC funds, for the Lomita Corridor Pedestrian Safety Improvement Plan (LCPSIP) Project; and
3.
Approve by resolution the authorization of a grant application to CalTrans in the amount of $654,350 for the Walnut Street Intersection Improvement Project.
Item #11
12.
PRESENTATION AND DISCUSSION OF THE CITY'S DRAFT RETAIL ANALYSIS AND DOWNTOWN STRATEGY ACTION: After Council review provide feedback on the colored renderings; and direct staff to solicit business, property owner and constituent feedback of the draft Retail Analysis and Downtown Strategy.
Item #12
13.
AUTHORIZATION FOR ENHANCED PUBLIC SAFETY AND TRAFFIC ENFORCEMENT PROGRAM ACTION: That the City Council authorize the proposed Enhanced Public Safety and Traffic Enforcement Program and make the necessary amendment to the City Manager's Law Enforcement Budget not to exceed $20,000.
Item #13
14.
APPOINTMENT TO COMMISSION VACANCY - PARKS & RECREATION COMMISSION
Presented by City Manager Smoot
ACTION: That the City Council make an appointment to the Parks & Recreation Commission.
Item #14
15.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned to the next Regular Meeting to be held on August 7, 2018, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in the City Hall lobby and bulletin board, and posted on the City's website not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. A copy of said Agenda is on file in the Office of the City Clerk.
Item #8
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
